dataset.description: Dataset consists of shotgun sequencing data from Iron Age skull from Latvia with multiple lytic bone lesions.

distribution.title: Shotgun sequencing data was obtained from petrous bone and lytic lesions of an Iron Age skull from Latvia, to study possible causative agents for observed pathology using preserved ancient genetic material.
